formulas.formula: A clear plan to pay off every card, and see the day you're debt-free.
1. Cards: list each card with its balance on a date, the APR, credit limit and minimum payment rule.
2. Still on Cards: type how much you can put toward all your cards each month, and pick a strategy.
3. Payment Log: log payments, new charges, interest and fees as they post. Balances update on their own.
4. Payoff Plan shows when each card will be paid off and your debt-free date. Minimums Only shows what happens if you only pay the minimum.
5. Card Calculator: try a payment amount, a payoff deadline, or a balance transfer for any card.
Extra money goes to the highest APR first. Saves the most interest.
Extra money goes to the smallest balance first. Quick wins keep you going.
Number the cards yourself in the My Order column (1 = first).
When a card is paid off, its payment rolls into the next card automatically.
Most cards charge 1% of the balance plus that month's interest, or a flat amount (like $35), whichever is higher. Check your statement and adjust Min % and Min $.
Try to keep each card under 30% of its limit; it helps your credit score.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: paid off or low utilization.
Red: over the limit, payment too low, or an entry to check.
Thank you for your purchase! You've got this.
Your cards and your plan settings.
Blank = this year. Used by Monthly History.
Optional. Blank = today. The plan starts the month after.
Total for all cards each month. Blank = minimums only.

=IF(TRIM($B{row}&"")="","",ROUND(SUMIFS('Payment Log'!$K$6:$K$1005,'Payment Log'!$H$6:$H$1005,ROW()-10,'Payment Log'!$I$6:$I$1005,"Payment",'Payment Log'!$J$6:$J$1005,1)+SUMIFS('Payment Log'!$K$6:$K$1005,'Payment Log'!$H$6:$H$1005,ROW()-10,'Payment Log'!$I$6:$I$1005,"Credit",'Payment Log'!$J$6:$J$1005,1),2))

=IF(N(C6)>0,IF(N(C6)<P21,"Budget is less than your minimums ("&TEXT(P21,"$#,##0.00")&"): the plan pays minimums only.","Extra each month: "&TEXT(N(C6)-P21,"$#,##0.00")),"No budget yet: the plan uses your minimums ("&TEXT(P21,"$#,##0.00")&").")
Payments and credits lower a balance. Charges, interest and fees raise it. Only entries after a card's Balance As Of date count.
Late fee waived after a call

section_bars.label: MONTH BY MONTH (BALANCE AT MONTH END)

formulas.formula: Your plan: every month the budget pays each card's minimum, and the rest goes to the next card in your strategy. Paid-off cards roll their payment forward.
What happens if you only ever pay each card's minimum (and stop using the cards). Compare it with your plan.
Pick a card and try different payments. Estimates assume no new charges.
What happened each month this year, across all cards (entries that count toward your balances).
